title: Bit-perfect audio player
description: Bypass the system mixer. Send bit-perfect audio up to 768 kHz and DSD512 straight to your USB DAC. No tracking, no ads.

value.title: Pure sound.
value.lede: Bypass the system mixer. Send bit-perfect audio straight to your USB DAC.

value.title: AI Enhanced Audio Player.
value.lede: Running 100% offline on your phone's silicon. Real-time high-frequency harmonic restoration, stem isolation, and acoustic timbral matching—engineered with mathematical honesty. No audio ever leaves your phone.

modules.title: AI Enhancer
modules.description: Restores 14–22 kHz high-frequency harmonics lost to lossy compression. Runs on-device via NPU with automatic CPU fallback.

modules.title: AI Karaoke
modules.description: Real-time 2- and 4-stem vocal and instrument isolation. Mute vocals or extract solo parts offline with zero latency.
modules.note: 100% offline. Zero audio leaves your phone.

modules.title: AI Mix
modules.description: Sonic Scan maps timbre and energy across your library for seamless, harmonically matched transitions.
modules.note: On-device CPU analysis. No tracking or cloud metadata.

value.footnote: Full neural model requires a supported hardware neural accelerator.

capabilities.title: 8× upsampling
capabilities.specs: Up to 384 kHz, with linear or minimum phase filters.

capabilities.title: Inter-sample headroom
capabilities.specs: Lowers the level just enough that peaks never clip inside the DAC.

capabilities.title: 32-band parametric EQ
capabilities.specs: Seven filter shapes and AutoEQ profiles for your headphones.

capabilities.title: Crossfeed and tube warmth
capabilities.specs: Three crossfeed presets for headphones, plus even and odd harmonics.

value.title: The system mixer changes your music on the way out.
value.titleAccent: This app sends it to your USB DAC unchanged.

facts.title: Your own files
facts.desc: FLAC, ALAC, WAV and DSD, from your own storage.

facts.title: Straight to your DAC
facts.desc: The app talks to your USB DAC directly. While it plays, other apps cannot use the DAC.

facts.title: Your music stays on the phone

items.desc: Direct USB DAC output, past the system mixer. Up to 768 kHz and DSD512.
Rebuilds high frequencies that compression removes. Off by default.
Parametric EQ, graphic EQ, or AutoEQ calibration profiles. One-tap bypass.
Browse your local files instantly by folder, album, artist or tag.
Stream to cast-enabled speakers and TVs, or receive from your network.
Headphone crossfeed, tag-based ReplayGain, and true-peak protection.

value.title: Your listening never leaves the phone.

commitments.title: No ads
commitments.desc: No ads and no ad SDKs. Your music, library, history and favourites stay on your phone.

commitments.title: No tracking
commitments.desc: The app has no advertising ID and collects no play history.

commitments.title: AI runs on your phone
commitments.desc: After a one-time model download, AI features run on your phone. No audio is uploaded.

value.note: The app goes online for album art, lyrics, AutoEQ profiles, internet radio and subscription checks. Crash reports can be turned off in settings.
